column3: MT 88:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces, but this copy closes the brace early and puts the rest in parentheses; “on Mahalath, to sing” is transliterated “Mahalath Leannoth.” “Day” is rendered “by day.”
Close to the Hebrew; “is surfeited with troubles” is rendered “has had enough troubles.”
“Set free among the dead” is rendered “Forsaken among the dead.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Your breakers” is rendered “Your waves.”
Close to the Hebrew; “abominations” is rendered “an object of loathing.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the shades” is rendered “the departed spirits.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I am perplexed” is rendered “I am overcome.”
“My acquaintances—darkness” is rendered “My acquaintances are in darkness.”
